character_facts: Lothar is someone the opening speaker interrupts and mocks directly.
Agnar has a tragic past that he is recounting to Oda.
Agnar seeks revenge and is willing to use deception as part of his plan.
Agnar wants both vengeance and a later escape into obscurity.
Oda is allied closely enough with Agnar to be included in his plan and imagined future.
The mechanical speaker/narrator has a derisive attitude toward human sexuality and toward Lothar.

plot_events: An off-panel speaker taunts Lothar with crude comments contrasting human sexuality with mechanical perfection.

A spacecraft is shown departing through space from a large structure or vessel.

Agnar says he will present Oda as a bound captive to support his plan.
Agnar describes a future in which, after annihilating certain witches, they will escape to a distant planet and live anonymously as a normal family.

uncertainties: Some small caption and speech text at the top of the page is difficult to read precisely, so the exact wording of the crude opening taunt may be imperfectly interpreted.

visual_summary: The page opens with close-up panels of machinery or a robot-like face while an obscene, mocking speech about human sexuality is delivered off-panel to someone identified as Lothar. A second mechanical, yellow-striped figure narrates a flashback. The flashback shows a spacecraft leaving a large industrial structure in space, then cuts to three panels of Agnar and Oda together aboard or near the craft: Agnar asks for Oda's help in carrying out revenge, says he will pretend to have captured her, and imagines that after destroying certain enemies they will flee to a distant planet and live as an ordinary family. Oda answers submissively each time.
